{{Quote|Once we're inside the cruiser we make our way to C-Deck. That's where their communication center is housed.|Colonel Gascon to D-Squad|<ref name="SW" />}}
'''C-Deck''' was a deck on the [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Providence-class carrier/destroyer]] of the [[Super tactical droid/Legends|Super tactical droid]] [[Aut-O/Legends|Aut-O]]. It contained the [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] communication's center, where the Separatist [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] was kept. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the C-Deck was hacked into by the [[D-Squad/Legends|D-Squad]], an elite group of droids put together for this specific task. C-Deck contained a vault with an encryption module that was stolen by the D-Squad to decipher a Confederate transmission sent out by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].<ref name="SW" />
